proposed_widenings.name: bond_objects
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's core deterministic effect is creating a persistent adhesive bond between two objects. The current effect vocabulary can target an object, but it cannot author a cross-object bonded state with removal constraints.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "This viscous, milky-white substance can form a permanent adhesive bond between any two objects."

proposed_widenings.name: dual_object_attachment
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing attachment grammar can point at one object, target, or area. Sovereign Glue requires selecting two object endpoints for one activation, not one.

notes: Magic-item activation family fits the ounce pool and Utilize action cost, but the surface cannot honestly express a permanent two-object adhesive bond that can be broken only by specific counter-agents. I therefore did not author a placeholder Dhall/JSON content file.
